from math import isqrt, prod

n = 33146799
claimed = [3, 7, 1578419]

def prime_factorization(value):
    factors = []
    while value % 2 == 0:
        factors.append(2)
        value //= 2
    divisor = 3
    while divisor * divisor <= value:
        while value % divisor == 0:
            factors.append(divisor)
            value //= divisor
        divisor += 2
    if value > 1:
        factors.append(value)
    return factors

def is_prime(value):
    if value < 2:
        return False
    if value % 2 == 0:
        return value == 2
    return all(value % d != 0 for d in range(3, isqrt(value) + 1, 2))

actual = prime_factorization(n)
expected = sorted(set(actual))
valid = all(is_prime(p) and n % p == 0 for p in claimed)
complete = sorted(set(claimed)) == expected

print("Number:", n)
print("Exact prime factorization:", actual)
print("Expected distinct prime factors:", expected)
print("Submitted factors:", claimed)
print("Submitted product:", prod(claimed))
print("Submitted primality:", [(p, is_prime(p)) for p in claimed])
print("CHECK PASS" if valid and complete else "CHECK FAIL")
